data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement emit-summary phase: after rails-sdk-add (or its skip), print a structured summary of what was created, next commands to run (e.g., `cd my-prototype && make build`), and pointers to docs.
**Why**: Non-technical users need a clear handoff at the end of the installer; the summary doubles as install-time documentation.
**Scope**:
- IN: Final stdout block listing project root, app subdir, applied flags, next-step commands (make build, make rails-runner), and links to docs.
- OUT: Telemetry; analytics; non-stdout output channels.

## Done Definitions
- When complete, the summary block is printed exactly once at successful exit and is consistent across template variants (rails/nextjs/flask) ← Satisfies: SC1, SC2
- When complete, summary lists the project root, app subdir, applied flags, next-step commands, and doc links ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for the summary content per template variant

## Considerations
- [Maintainability] Keep summary content data-driven from the phase outputs; do not hardcode per-template forks

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a non-technical user, the emit-summary phase reports next steps after a successful scaffold
